tables.name: billing_accounts
tables.business_identity: Internal account plus scoped Stripe customer
checks: verified binding requires principal and customer; customer association is immutable after verification except separately audited identity repair
unresolved Finance accounts cannot grant access
scope mode must match trusted deployment and credentials
binding_revision >= 0; projection revisions begin at 1 on first materialized row
tables.allowed_readers: checkout; synchronizer; Finance; authenticated read adapters
tables.retention: Retain until audited retention approval; no automatic deletion in this contract.

tables.name: billing_checkout_attempts
checks: frozen parameters/presentation/key never replaced after an uncertain response
no client secret in URL, logs, localStorage, sessionStorage or persisted attempt parameters
replay deadline preserves current conservative replay window; expired uncertainty requires attention, not a new key
claim_generation >= 0; projection revisions begin at 1 on first materialized row
tables.allowed_readers: existing checkout API and owned resumption adapters
tables.retention: Retain until audited retention approval; no automatic deletion in this contract.

tables.name: billing_price_catalog
checks: every ownership/approval change increments revision and appends immutable operation audit
unsupported legacy registry resource types block migration rather than being discarded
revision >= 0; projection revisions begin at 1 on first materialized row
application disablement invalidates all its catalog proofs atomically by updating affected price revisions/application_active; checked at every proof commit, not cached as an eternal approval
tables.retention: Retain until audited retention approval; no automatic deletion in this contract.

tables.name: billing_subscriptions

unique.where: plan='pro' AND status IN ('active','trialing') AND NOT terminal

checks: verified customer/account and approved price required for Pro
multiple live subscriptions block ambiguous entitlement; never resolve by arbitrary row order
revision advances only for semantic changes; task completion is still audited for unchanged/stale outcomes
terminal state cannot be resurrected by an obsolete event
revision >= 0; projection revisions begin at 1 on first materialized row
tables.retention: Retain until audited retention approval; no automatic deletion in this contract.

tables.name: billing_event_inbox
tables.business_identity: Scoped source intent and projection task
checks: same source identity requires matching immutable evidence digest across task kinds
evidence stays bounded, minimal and versioned; no nested receipt/work/routing state machines
completed task cannot reopen; approved correction is a new causally linked source intent
lease is canonical for this task; authority stores reference/generation, not another expiry clock
claim_generation >= 0; projection revisions begin at 1 on first materialized row
failure_count >= 0; projection revisions begin at 1 on first materialized row
claim_count >= 0; projection revisions begin at 1 on first materialized row
tables.authoritative_writer: admitVerifiedEvent / claimTask / atomic commit or defer commands
tables.allowed_readers: worker; authenticated recovery; safe diagnostic projection
tables.retention: Retain until audited retention approval; no automatic deletion in this contract.

tables.name: billing_authority
tables.business_identity: One authority generation per account/domain or coordinator resource
checks: at most one active operation reference; operation owns its sole token and lease expiry
access and Finance domains are independent; identity binding uses one shared guarded command
both legacy and simplified commit paths check engine and generation during migration
shadow engine cannot own access/Finance commit authority
scope migration default is persisted, not inferred from per-request deployment flags
checkout operations hold the access domain; Finance cannot rewrite verified account identity
billing_account_id equals resource_key account identity for access/finance; coordinator keys are a separate closed namespace
active operation reference resolves to same scope/account/domain and current engine/generation; expired old holder never clears new reference
generation >= 0; projection revisions begin at 1 on first materialized row
tables.retention: Retain until audited retention approval; no automatic deletion in this contract.

tables.name: billing_operations
checks: audit records are insert-only in their entirety, including updated_at
only run records have mutable cursor/coverage/status; each checkpoint appends a distinct audit record
facts are closed typed summaries, not arbitrary provider payload or hidden task states
completed task has exactly one successful completion audit; checkpoint identities are deterministic
for audit rows outcome, generation and revisions are fixed at insertion; run-only columns are NULL
run/audit outcome values use the closed result/error catalog in behavior.json; no exception text
tables.retention: Retain until audited retention approval; no automatic deletion in this contract.

tables.name: billing_finance_subscriptions
tables.business_identity: Scoped Stripe object; deterministic derived key for attempts/activity
checks: retain all current normalization, money, discount, tax, completeness and ownership checks
all rows written by one task commit atomically with task completion/audit

global_constraints: No schema installation or runtime import permitted in Phase 1
All identifiers are scoped; environment/mode/signature guards precede database creation
All financial integer/decimal amounts remain lossless; never normalize via JS Number
Every FK target must be the same Stripe scope; missing dependencies park rather than weakening FK/ownership checks
No retention deletion is authorized: terminal dedupe identities, canceled tombstones, unresolved attempts and legal/audit records cannot be discarded automatically

json_contracts.evidence: Versioned bounded discriminated record for source/task kind. Required correlation/scope/event time, verified subject references and approved fixed fields copied from current minimal-evidence contract. No nested lifecycle, retry, routing, authority or completion fields; preserve current prepareBillingWorkEvidence validation until reviewed replacement.
json_contracts.parameters: Exact frozen current checkout/customer/update request parameter contract, including presentation and approved price; digest covers canonical full parameters. Provider results, secret keys and client secrets prohibited.

ownership_provenance.rules: same scoped invoice/customer/subscription anchors; complete invoice lines; exact payment/allocation checks at charge commit; all price registry revisions active/current; zero guessed shared-customer authorization

json_contracts.operations.facts: Closed discriminated summary by operation_kind: subscription (task, before/after digest/revision, order decision); Finance (scoped affected row keys/revisions and proof anchors); checkout (attempt key/digest/result identity, never client secret); ownership (old/new revision/state); handover (old/new engine/generation/checkpoint); recovery (parent task/fixed reason); reconciliation (window/resource/page/count/coverage). Private RLS evidence, never log output.
json_contracts.operations.cursor: Run-only closed resource/endpoint/after/window cursor; NULL for immutable audit.
json_contracts.operations.coverage: Run-only discovered/admitted/resolved/attention counts plus resource/window/start/end, quality partial|complete. Complete only after all included tasks resolved or explicit attention.
